title: Chapter 22: Dense, panoptic and promptable segmentation

entries.claim: Atrous convolution expands field of view while controlling feature-map resolution; ASPP samples multiple rates to capture scale context
entries.notes: Effective kernel size formula is derived from discrete sample spacing, not an additional dense kernel parameter count.

entries.claim: DeepLabv3+ adds a decoder to DeepLabv3 and applies depthwise separable convolution in ASPP and decoder modules
entries.notes: Paper's reported VOC/Cityscapes scores are configuration-specific and intentionally not generalized in the article.

entries.claim: Panoptic segmentation unifies semantic labels for stuff with instance identities for things and introduces Panoptic Quality
entries.notes: PQ matching is category-aware and one-to-one with IoU threshold greater than 0.5.

entries.claim: Mask2Former uses pixel decoder, query-based Transformer decoder and mask-constrained cross-attention for semantic, instance and panoptic segmentation
entries.notes: Post-processing differs by task; shared architecture does not remove task-specific label semantics.

entries.claim: SAM has image encoder, prompt encoder and mask decoder; supports point/box/mask prompts and multiple masks for ambiguous prompts
entries.notes: Text prompting is exploratory in the original paper; overall latency includes the heavyweight image encoder.

entries.claim: SAM 2 extends promptable segmentation to video using streaming memory and treats images as one-frame videos
entries.notes: SAM 2 is a later model, not a component of the original 2023 SAM.
